# Test-set results (auto-generated by src/train_model.py)

| Model | Accuracy | Precision | Recall | F1 | ROC-AUC | False negatives |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Logistic Regression | 0.708 | 0.571 | 0.667 | 0.615 | 0.810 | 18 |
| Random Forest | 0.727 | 0.591 | 0.722 | 0.650 | 0.818 | 15 |

**Final model:** Random Forest

Random Forest was selected because it achieved the highest mean cross-validated F2-score on the training data (0.739 vs 0.704 for Logistic Regression). F2 weights recall twice as much as precision, which suits screening where missing a diabetic case is costly. On the held-out test set it reached recall 0.722 with 15 false negatives and ROC-AUC 0.818.
